contact.name: Sal
contact.intro: Sal runs the lock-up behind the depot. Cash, no receipts, no questions. Marge would hate this.
contact.line_low: Keep it quiet and we're fine.
contact.line_high: You're warm, kid. Lie low a day.

branches.name: Fencing
branches.blurb: Goods go to Sal for more than the market pays. Nobody asks where they came from.

branches.name: Night moves
branches.blurb: Moves after dark for people who do not want a paper trail. Big pay, bigger heat.

branches.name: Knock-offs
branches.blurb: Make it on the bench, sell it as the real thing.

branches.name: Cover
branches.blurb: Ways to cool off when the heat climbs.

nodes.name: Small fence
nodes.blurb: Sell one trade good to Sal at 1.5x.

nodes.name: The good customer
nodes.blurb: Sal pays 2.4x for anything restored or mint.

nodes.name: After hours
nodes.blurb: Take a no-questions move at 1.6x pay. The route is dark.

nodes.name: The quiet route
nodes.blurb: Night moves pay 2.6x and the alley never costs heat.

nodes.name: Close enough
nodes.blurb: Sell a made thing as the branded one at 1.7x.

nodes.name: Provenance
nodes.blurb: Knock-offs sell at 3.0x and come with a story.

nodes.name: Lie low
nodes.blurb: Close up early: heat drops by 4, the shop misses a day's custom ($30).

nodes.name: A friend on the force
nodes.blurb: $120 buys a quiet word: the last visit is forgotten.

visits: A clipboard and a polite knock. Two trade goods confiscated and a fine.
Someone in a grey coat asks about the lock-up. You pay to make them bored.
Marge hears a rumour. She says nothing, which is worse. Rep slips.

lines_up: You drive a hard one. Done.
lines_down: Greedy. The price just went down.
Keep pushing and there's no price.
haggle.line_walk: We're done here. Come back when you've learned manners.
haggle.line_open: Cash, no receipt. Here's my number.

lines_caught: Someone's cousin knew the real one. Word got round.
The label peeled. The buyer did not laugh.
Wrong font on the stamp. A collector noticed.

story.subject: You're alright
story.body:
Three deals and no fuss. That's rarer than you think.

There's a van with no plates behind the depot. Night work pays double and nobody counts the boxes.

— S

story.subject: Patrols
story.body:
They've put two cars on nights. Keep it under the limit near them and stay out of the alley when they're looking, or don't. Your call, your heat.

— S

story.subject: The big one
story.body:
A whole office, after dark, three times the money. One night only. Take it from the back room when you're ready, and bring the truck back clean.

— S

big_score.title: The big one
big_score.brief: A whole office, lights off, by morning. Three times the money, every patrol in town awake.
